author: DonutDevBen
quote:
This has to be the worst game I’ve played in 40 years. 13 years, billions spent and absolutely nothing about this “game” is fun. 
Some activities are restricted, some are blocked and some just weren’t even an option. 
A game that should be a do anything chaos engine, is reduced to a relationship simulator, emasculating the main male character at every opportunity. 
No level of fancy graphics or free roaming can save this dumpster fire ****. 
There’s nothing challenging about it, probably because they don’t want to cause anyone anxiety if they failed a mission, it’s just dull, boring, and a huge disappointment. Don’t waste your money, if I could refund it I would.
